headline: President Trump Nominates UFC Executive For Press Secretary Role
seoTitle: Trump Nominates UFC Boss for Press Secretary
metaDescription: President Trump has nominated the UFC leader to serve as White House press secretary, following the recent departure of the previous office holder.
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump has offered the White House press secretary position to the head of the UFC.
The administration has been without a permanent press secretary since October 16.
The previous official, Katie Zacharia, resigned from the role after serving less than a week.
aiContextParagraph: The White House press secretary position has remained vacant since the departure of Katie Zacharia on October 16. Zacharia held the role for less than one week before leaving the administration, creating a gap in the government's official communications department. Following this vacancy, President Trump has officially extended an offer for the position to the head of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). In addition to this staffing announcement, reports indicate that the President has advocated for the initiation of criminal investigations directed at members of the Democratic Party. The offer represents a new appointment strategy within the executive branch as the administration seeks to fill the press office role after the recent period of turnover and administrative instability that characterized the early tenure of the previous appointee.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to a high volume of public search interest regarding the UFC executive's potential shift into federal politics.

sources.articleTitle: Trump offers UFC boss press secretary post, urges criminal probes of Democrats
